CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content organization present.

COD.rationale: For listed referents the report explicitly identifies content (C), an organization/presentation status (O) and a separate origin/status record (D) with matching referent and time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to content presentation or access for the same referents.

C.rationale: Multiple literal content-identification substrings name specific contents (red/blue) and their coordinate sets.

D.rationale: The report separately records content identity (red/blue coordinate sets) and distinct origin/status objects, distinguishing identity from organization/presentation.

O.rationale: The text states how contents are organized/presented (coordinate orientation and conditional record kinds and partitioned coordinate sets).
